scores.notes: Left is a very deep sheer-walled cylindrical shaft under a dark night-blue sky lit by torches; right is a shallower round pit with a stone staircase built into its wall, a courtyard gate and palm above, in bright full daylight. The internal staircase/depth and the night-vs-bright-day lighting conflict.
Peter (foreground in courtyard; man stepping from boat) has the same short curly dark-and-grey hair, grey beard, weathered middle-aged face and build in both.
Both show a small boat on a dark, wave-tossed sea at night under a moonlit storm sky, with a rocky/hilly coastline on the right; compatible place from a different viewpoint.

Both show the same lake with hilly shores and a small settlement along the shoreline; the left is mid-storm at night and the right is the storm easing as described, so the lighting change is asked for.
Daniel (man being hauled from the pit; man standing before the king) has the same short grey hair, short grey beard, lean older face and skin tone, in the same blue cloak over white tunic.
Both show a sandy, rock-strewn path between towering wave walls running to the horizon under a dim sky; the far end differs only in visibility (fire glow vs low cliffs), nothing conflicts.
Daniel at the feast and in the den both have short grey hair, short grey beard, slim older face and the same blue robe over white tunic.
Both show a lake bordered by hills/cliffs with stone houses near the shore; left is the calm after the storm and right the storm, a change the descriptions call for.
Both show a pebbly beach with a smoking fire on the right, a long lake between hills, and a white-walled village climbing the right shore under soft morning light.
Both show a fishing boat on a stormy night sea under a moon in rain, with a hilly shore and small village on the left; consistent place.
Daniel being lifted out of the pit and Daniel at the feast share short grey hair, a short grey beard, lean older face and medium-brown skin, in matching blue robe.
Zoomed faces: Daniel at the feast and in the den have the same close-cropped grey hair, trimmed grey beard, gaunt older face and brown skin, plus the same blue robe and scroll case.
Peter by the brazier and Peter lifting the lame man both have curly dark-and-grey hair, salt-and-pepper beard, broad weathered face and similar build.
